tools.name: get_tool_guide
tools.description: Discovery helper: returns the standard prompt template, argument template, output-interpretation guide and related resources for one or all SmartMoney77 tools, so you can call them correctly without guessing. Example: { "tool": "fire_number" }.

tools.name: list_calculators
tools.description: List every SmartMoney77 calculator with its slug, accepted URL parameters and supported languages/currencies. Call this before build_calculator_link. Example: { "group": "history" } returns only the 'what if I had invested' tools.

tools.name: build_calculator_link
tools.description: Build a deep link to a SmartMoney77 calculator with pre-filled values that auto-calculate on open. Use list_calculators first to find the slug and its parameters. Example: { "calculator": "bitcoin-history", "lang": "en", "params": { "amount": 1000, "year": 2015 } } → https://smartmoney77.com/en/bitc

tools.name: compound_interest
tools.description: Project the future value of an initial amount plus monthly contributions at a given annual return (monthly compounding), and return a link to the same calculation on SmartMoney77. tools.name: fire_number
tools.description: Calculate the financial-independence (FIRE) target from monthly expenses using the 4% rule, plus how many years of saving are needed. Example: { "expenses": 4000, "saving": 1500, "current": 50000 } → fireNumber 1,200,000.

tools.name: credit_card_payoff
tools.description: Calculate how long it takes to clear a credit card balance at a fixed monthly payment and APR, plus the total interest paid. Example: { "balance": 10000, "payment": 400, "rate": 18 } → about 32 months and ~2,600 in interest. Errors when the payment is smaller than the first month's interest.

tools.name: emergency_fund
tools.description: Calculate how many months of expenses current savings cover, the target emergency fund size, the gap, and how long it takes to close it. Example: { "expenses": 3000, "savings": 6000, "contribution": 500, "target": 6 } → 2 months covered, target 18,000, gap 12,000, 24 months to go.

tools.name: inflation_check
tools.description: Calculate how much purchasing power cash loses to inflation over time, and what nominal amount keeps the same buying power. Example: { "amount": 100000, "rate": 3, "years": 10 } → realValue ≈ 74,409 and equivalentNeeded ≈ 134,392.

tools.name: latte_factor
tools.description: Calculate what a small recurring daily expense (coffee, cigarettes, takeaway) costs over time and what it would grow to if invested instead. tools.name: killer_fees
tools.description: Compare how much a high management fee costs versus a low fee over time on a portfolio with monthly contributions. Example: { "portfolio": 100000, "monthly": 1000, "highFee": 1.5, "lowFee": 0.3, "years": 25 } → the low-fee portfolio ends materially higher.

tools.name: cost_of_waiting
tools.description: Compare investing the same monthly amount starting at an early age versus a later age, and show what the delay costs by retirement. Example: { "monthly": 1000, "start": 25, "compare": 35, "retire": 67, "rate": 8 } → a large gap created mostly by compounding, not by the extra contributions.

tools.description: Compute what a past investment would be worth today (or in a later year), using the same yearly low/high average prices as the SmartMoney77 history calculators. tools.name: compare_investments
tools.description: Run the same "what if I had invested" calculation across 2-8 assets and rank them by final value. USD only, same yearly low/high average pricing as the SmartMoney77 history calculators. Assets: bitcoin, ethereum, solana, sp500, nasdaq100, nvidia, microsoft, meta, apple, tesla, amazon, google, netfli

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: list_calculators · Public sink: build_share_pack · Destructive: compare_investments.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: list_calculators · Public sink: build_share_pack · Destructive: compare_investments

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
